title: RootNullEnumEmptyMember
$comment: Issue #267 (b). A const enum is `type Root string` with a list of constants and, until this was fixed, no UnmarshalJSON at all -- so a JSON null was a silent Go no-op that left the zero value behind and Validate judged that zero rather than the document. Every enum whose zero is not a member caught it by accident; this one admits "" and so accepted the null outright.
